name: Baoding Wang

title: Advanced Ultrasonics, Non-contact NDE & Intelligent Imaging
先进超声、非接触无损评价与智能成像
subtitle: Experimental Systems · Wave Physics · Computational Imaging · AI-Assisted Research
实验系统 · 波动物理 · 计算成像 · AI 辅助科研
paragraphs: I develop Laser–EMAT and air-coupled ultrasonic systems for non-contact inspection of metals, composites and additively manufactured parts.
我研发激光–电磁超声和空耦超声系统，对金属、复合材料及增材制造构件开展非接触检测。
I build LabVIEW acquisition tools and use C++ and Python to turn ultrasonic measurements, wave physics and multiphysics models into computational imaging methods.
我开发 LabVIEW 测控工具，使用 C++ 和 Python 将超声测量、波动物理与多物理场模型转化为计算成像方法。
My industry experience in mechanical design and software engineering informs how I design instruments, automate experiments and validate imaging methods.
机械设计与软件工程的工业经历为仪器设计、实验自动化与成像方法验证提供了工程基础。
